UC San Diego Health is ranked the No. 1 hospital system in San Diego. That's just one reason to choose us as your health care provider.

Our Mission is to deliver outstanding patient care through commitment to the community, groundbreaking research and inspired teaching.

Our Vision is to create a healthier world — one life at a time — through new science, new medicine and new cures.

When it comes to your health care, quality matters. So when U.S. News & World Report ranked UC San Diego Health as among the nation's best in nine medical and surgical specialties — more than any hospital system in San Diego — we were thrilled for our patients. These distinctions proudly reflect the dedication of our physician, nursing and research staff. Our renowned physicians and scientists have made contributions in numerous fields, including minimally invasive surgeries, personalized cancer therapy, cardiovascular treatment, and transplantation.
